decisions.reason: The operator training programme is a low-cost extension of the firm's established service offer and is publicly committed on its own page, so management will keep it and attribute any weak uptake to pandemic-related travel and training restrictions.
The fourth rotary axis accessory complements the core milling systems with little added investment, so there is little reason to withdraw it.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core and only lightly showcased, but it embodies the announced move toward future-oriented materials processing, so management will persist and blame slow results on an immature market and the pandemic.
The high-speed CNC milling line carries the heaviest R&D investment and the most visible commitment, and it is central to the firm's identity, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The automatic tool change system is presented on its own page and strengthens the firm's automation and efficiency promise, so the firm remains committed to it.
